sections.title: What changed
items: Telepath works just as before: this release updates the built-in code every Snug app uses to talk to Snug to the version new apps are built with.
Customized your copy? You can skip this one — your version keeps working as it is.

sections.title: What's new
items: The app is untouched — this release carries Telepath's wiki and the verbatim build prompts into copies installed before docs were seeded.

sections.title: What's new
items: Your WhatsApp, live in your file — with an analyst who knows the room.
Drafts replies in your voice; you approve every send.
Desktop only: the session lives in a local helper this app runs for you.
